The first instalment will be effect on condition that [PARTY_C] can raise at least US$1.1 million additional funding in 2002.
findings.explanation: Your first payment of US$220,000 is made conditional on the client raising US$1.1 million in additional funding in 2002. If the client fails to raise that funding, your first payment is withheld, meaning payment depends entirely on an event the client controls and that is outside your control.
findings.suggested_change: The first instalment shall be due and payable within thirty (30) days of the Effective Date, without condition precedent.

findings.quoted_text: [PARTY_C] may terminate this Agreement by giving thirty (30) days written notice to the CEIS.
findings.explanation: You (CEIS) have no matching right to end the contract without cause; only the client can. If the client walks at year 5 of the 20-year term, you keep the advance payment for the elapsed 5 years but must hand back the rest (plus interest on that refund), so you are stuck with whatever costs you already incurred in the last 30 days of notice with no right to exit on your own terms.
findings.suggested_change: Either Party may terminate this Agreement by giving thirty (30) days written notice to the other Party, and the Client shall pay the Contractor for all Content transmitted during the period from the Effective Date through the effective date of termination.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi,

Before I sign off, I'd like to flag one point in the relevant clause of the agreement.

- The current wording makes my first instalment of US$220,000 conditional on raising at least US$1.1 million in additional funding in 2002. In effect, payment rests on an outcome I have no influence over, so if that funding is not secured, my first payment would be held back. I would suggest amending the clause so that the first instalment is due and payable within thirty (30) days of the Effective Date, without condition precedent.

I'm happy to discuss this at your convenience. Thanks for your understanding, and please let me know if there's anything else you'd like adjusted before we proceed.

Best,
